Roboto.ttf is the normal-width variable Roboto from Google Fonts commit
45e3d5269e4a17d823f6d84470bc084dc5ae46f6, `ofl/roboto/Roboto[wdth,wght].ttf`.
It exercises custom-font exclusion: its normal stretch outranks the shipped
Roboto Condensed for the normalized family `Roboto` if admitted to the book.
The upstream OFL license is included.
